description: Token parity boundary vs prefix-cached agent
measurement: Parity with prefix-cached agent on fixed-size task (N=5, 30-60 chars)

details.context: Original baselines were direct CoT and Qwenputer trace-tokens, not prefix-cached agent
details.framing_error: Batch 1 added prefix-cached agent, found parity, wrote as conclusion. It is a BOUND, not the conclusion.
details.boundary: On small fixed-size tasks, a competent tool call ties LMPU. The value is NOT 'we save tokens on every task'.
details.honest_framing: Cost scales with decisions, not bytes. Marginal wait cost is zero. Applies to data-heavy, long-running, multi-tenant workloads.
